convention_rule: Guess: the lit post's left-to-right position (out of four) is the index into candidates sorted by ID (or by energy). Both orderings put P2 second. No earlier examples were given to confirm this.
basis: A: four posts, only the 2nd from left has a green lantern. B: a green post stands among plain posts, roughly 3rd from left, so B is ambiguous. Second by ID is P2, and second by energy is also P2. Second in the listed order would be P4. P3 is client-correct.
